archiveTitle: Daily Brief | MARVEL Tōkon Reveals Year-One DLC Roster

entries.headline: Tekken 8 Adds Roger Jr. on November 11 for Season 3 Pass Owners
entries.summary: Bandai Namco says Roger Jr. will arrive in Tekken 8 on November 11 for Season 3 Character Pass owners and on November 16 for everyone else. The game is available on PS5, Xbox Series, and PC.
entries.verification: The cited packet source supports the stated facts and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by Gematsu at 21:30 Beijing time on October 11.

entries.headline: GGKeeper Launches to Automatically Balance PC Game Startup Volume
entries.summary: Developer Naito released GGKeeper for Windows 11 on October 11. The free utility can normalize per-game volume, start games more quietly, and lower sound further through a conversation mode.
entries.verification: The cited packet source supports the stated facts and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 10:05 Beijing time on October 12.

entries.headline: This Week's PC Deals Include 75% Discounts and a Free Pony Island Offer
entries.summary: AUTOMATON's Steam deals roundup highlights Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii at 75% off for ¥1,732, Astroneer at 75% off for ¥875, and Pony Island free to claim through October 13.
entries.verification: The cited packet source supports the stated facts and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 15:21 Beijing time on October 11; prices and deadlines reflect the cited store snapshot.

entries.headline: Mick Gordon Says He Would Return to Doom If the Conditions Aligned
entries.summary: In an IGN interview at PAX Australia, Mick Gordon said he would return to the Doom series in a heartbeat if the many necessary conditions were met. No collaboration has been confirmed.
entries.verification: The cited packet source supports the stated facts and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by IGN at 08:01 Beijing time on October 12.

entries.headline: Fly Over! 100KM! Mountains! Will Switch From Free to Paid on November 16
entries.summary: The developer says the endless-flight game will become paid on November 16. Players who add it to their Steam library beforehand will retain access after the change.
entries.verification: The cited packet source supports the stated facts and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 08:30 Beijing time on October 12.

entries.headline: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls Reveals Its Year-One DLC Roster
entries.summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment revealed more Year-One fighters for the 4v4 tag game. Thor (Jane Foster), Venom, and Jubilee will follow the previously announced Phoenix and Cyclops.
entries.verification: The cited packet source supports the stated facts and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 07:48 Beijing time on October 12.

entries.headline: Indigenous-Created 2D Action Game Huni Kuin Appears at BGS 2026
entries.summary: 4Gamer's Brasil Game Show 2026 report describes Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena as a 2D action game based on tribal mythology, with Amazonian villagers contributing artwork and voices.
entries.verification: The cited packet source supports the stated facts and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by 4Gamer at 11:07 Beijing time on October 11.
